messages.subject: Extra variables added to output.
parts:
Hello,

When I run an analysis with two genotypes (called WT for wildtype and KO for knockout). My output has created a third category, also called WT, with only 1 sample in it. So there is KO, WT, and WT. I have checked to make sure the input file only has 2 genotype categories in it. Why is this third category coming up? I have attached the output files. 


Thanks!
